hero.title: Outreach Activities
hero.subtitle: Connecting with communities through education, innovation, and social responsibility

featured_story.title: Women in STEM Workshop
featured_story.description: The SPIE Student Chapter NIT Goa conducted an inspiring workshop at Sharada Mandir School, Panjim, focusing on sparking interest in STEM fields among middle school girls through hands-on experiments in physics, optics, and robotics.
featured_story.alt: Women in STEM Initiative by SPIE Student Chapter

cards.title: Light & Optics Workshops
cards.description: SPIE student chapter organized workshops at Mustifund High School and Damodar Higher Secondary School, introducing students to the fascinating world of light and optics through interactive demonstrations.

cards.title: All Goa Science Fair
cards.description: The inaugural All Goa Science Fair brought together 42 teams of grades 8-10 students to showcase innovative projects on "Science and technology for a clean and green tomorrow".

cards.title: Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign
cards.description: NIT Goa conducted comprehensive cleanliness drives in collaboration with Cuncolim Municipality Corporation, cleaning Demani Village adjacent to our campus and promoting environmental awareness.

cards.title: Arduino & Electronics Workshops
cards.description: Hands-on Arduino workshops introduce school students to basic electronics and programming concepts, fostering understanding of microcontroller applications in modern technology.

cards.title: Village Development Program
cards.description: Through Unnat Bharat Abhiyan, NIT Goa actively engages with adopted villages Kalay and Guirdolim, conducting surveys, participating in Gramsabha meetings, and implementing development initiatives.

cards.title: School Campus Visit Program
cards.description: Government High School students from Vidhyanagar, Aquem, Margao visited NIT Goa campus as part of the new Education Policy, attending lectures on Experimental Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.

cards.title: Health & Safety Initiatives
cards.description: NIT Goa organizes blood donation camps, health awareness programs, and Safai Mitra Suraksha Shivirs focusing on worker safety, hygiene, and overall community well-being.

cards.title: Engineering Day & Innovation Showcase
cards.description: Annual Engineering Day celebrations feature technical exhibitions, project demonstrations, and interactive sessions with school students, showcasing the latest research and innovations from all departments.

cards.title: STEM Educational Programs
cards.description: Comprehensive STEM programs introducing students to hands-on learning experiences in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics through interactive workshops and demonstrations.

cards.title: Rural Outreach Programs
cards.description: Rural outreach initiatives focusing on technology transfer, skill development, and infrastructure improvement to enhance quality of life in local villages through sustained community engagement. These programs include community surveys, skill development workshops, digital literacy training, and sustainable development projects that directly benefit rural communities around NIT Goa.

cards.title: Student Excellence & Recognition
cards.description: NIT Goa students consistently excel in national and international competitions, research projects, and innovation challenges, bringing recognition to the institute through their outstanding achievements. Students have won prestigious awards in robotics competitions, hackathons, research symposiums, and technical festivals across the country, showcasing the quality of education and innovation culture at NIT Goa.

cards.title: Special Events & Celebrations
cards.description: Cultural festivals, awareness campaigns, and special events that bring together the academic community and local residents in celebration of shared values and community spirit. These events include Independence Day celebrations, Republic Day ceremonies, cultural festivals, environmental awareness campaigns, and community gatherings that strengthen the bond between NIT Goa and the local community.
